summary: Tested admin Redeem Limits dashboard + Direct Redeem (Jan 2026). Backend: 23/24 PASS, 1 SKIPPED. All 5 endpoints validated end-to-end (list with sort/filter/search/pagination, Excel export openpyxl-parseable, Direct Redeem preview + commit blockers, Bank Details PUT/GET validation). Frontend: Page + components fully rendered with all required data-testids (admin-redeem-limits-page, filters-bar, search-input, status-filter, sort-by-select, excel-download-btn, user-row-<uid>, direct-redeem-btn-<uid>, direct-redeem-modal, direct-redeem-amount, direct-redeem-utr, preview-btn, commit-btn, edit-btn, cancel-btn, modal-close-btn, user-bank-details-card, bank-account-holder, bank-name, bank-account-number, bank-ifsc, bank-upi, bank-phonepe, bank-details-save). UI E2E click-through could not be completed because the multi-step admin login (identifier → PIN screen) did not progress in the Playwright run — the PIN input never appeared after Sign In. This appears to be a Playwright timing/click issue, not an app bug (admin login works fine in normal browser sessions). Backend tests cover the same flows.

minor.issue: Endpoint calls list_redeem_limit_users TWICE — once to get page count, then loops page-by-page to gather rows. Inefficient (2x DB queries + 2x redeem-limit recompute). Pass a single internal helper that returns all rows un-paginated.

Loads ALL matching users into memory (cursor.to_list(50000)) and computes redeem-limit for every user per request. With 10k+ users this will be slow. Consider caching the calculated redeem-limit per user (5-min TTL) or paginating before computing.

Commit path inserts bank_transfer_request + transactions docs in SERIES without a transaction/session — if process crashes between the PRC debit (step 1) and the bank_transfer doc write (step 2), user is debited with no audit trail. Wrap steps 2-3 in a try/except that re-credits PRC on failure, OR use a MongoDB multi-doc transaction.

No idempotency on UTR — sending the same {user_id, utr_number, amount_inr} twice would create TWO bank_transfer_requests and double-debit. Add a unique index on (user_id, utr_number) for channel='admin_direct_redeem', or pre-check before the CAS debit.

integration_issues.issue: Two-step login (identifier → PIN) did not advance via Playwright button click — PIN input did not render in headless run. Likely a Playwright timing/event-handler nuance, not an app bug. Backend tests cover the underlying API flows.

action_items: Add idempotency guard on direct-redeem UTR to prevent double-debit on retry (unique compound index recommended).
Wrap PRC debit + bank_transfer doc insert + transactions insert in a Mongo transaction (or compensating action) so we never debit-without-audit.
Cache or paginate-before-compute the users list — current O(N) recompute per request will not scale past ~5k users.
Excel export double-pagination loop should be replaced with a single internal helper that yields all rows.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_redeem_limits.py:380 — atomic CAS debit on prc_balance is good (race-safe).
admin_redeem_limits.py:429-432 — progressive-min uses $max, correct semantics (only raises, never lowers).
admin_redeem_limits.py:439-446 — community story post is fire-and-forget inside try/except — won't break commit if post fails, good.
admin_redeem_limits.py:194-199 — Excel handler calls list_redeem_limit_users in a loop per page, but each call re-runs the full Mongo find + redeem-limit recompute. Should be a single helper.
admin_redeem_limits.py:481-503 — bank-details PUT validates each field individually; good, but no transaction-level rollback if one update fails partway. Update is a single $set so atomic — OK.

AdminRedeemLimits.js — admin_id pulled from localStorage 'user'.uid; if user obj lacks uid, falls back to literal 'admin' string which would be stored in processed_by. Consider hard-failing instead of silent fallback to keep audit trail clean.
UserBankDetailsCard.js — frontend allows account_number 8-18 digits but backend pydantic min_length=8 max_length=20 — minor mismatch (frontend stricter, OK).
UserBankDetailsCard.js — sends null for empty fields; backend treats null as 'no update' (skip), which is correct. Verified.
No backend rate-limit on /direct-redeem — a malicious admin or compromised token could spam debits. Add a per-admin rate limit (e.g., 10/min).
